def solve_cvrp(instance):
    depot = instance["depot_index"]
    customers = list(instance["customer_ids"])
    demands = instance["demands"]
    capacity = instance["capacity"]
    matrix = instance["distance_matrix"]

    def route_load(route):
        s = 0
        for x in route:
            s += demands[x]
        return s

    def route_cost(route):
        if not route:
            return 0
        c = matrix[depot][route[0]] + matrix[route[-1]][depot]
        for i in range(len(route) - 1):
            c += matrix[route[i]][route[i + 1]]
        return c

    # --- Focused edit #1: Clarke-Wright savings constructive (feasible, deterministic) ---
    route_of = {}
    routes = []
    loads = []
    for c in customers:
        route_of[c] = len(routes)
        routes.append([c])
        loads.append(demands[c])

    def is_start_of_route(node, r):
        rt = routes[r]
        return rt and rt[0] == node

    def is_end_of_route(node, r):
        rt = routes[r]
        return rt and rt[-1] == node

    n = len(customers)
    savings = []
    for a in range(n):
        i = customers[a]
        di = matrix[depot][i]
        for b in range(a + 1, n):
            j = customers[b]
            s = di + matrix[depot][j] - matrix[i][j]
            savings.append((s, i, j))
    savings.sort(key=lambda t: (-t[0], t[1], t[2]))

    for _, i, j in savings:
        ri = route_of.get(i, -1)
        rj = route_of.get(j, -1)
        if ri == -1 or rj == -1 or ri == rj:
            continue
        li = loads[ri]
        lj = loads[rj]
        if li + lj > capacity:
            continue

        if is_end_of_route(i, ri) and is_start_of_route(j, rj):
            routes[ri] = routes[ri] + routes[rj]
        elif is_start_of_route(i, ri) and is_end_of_route(j, rj):
            routes[ri] = routes[rj] + routes[ri]
        elif is_end_of_route(i, ri) and is_end_of_route(j, rj):
            routes[ri] = routes[ri] + routes[rj][::-1]
        elif is_start_of_route(i, ri) and is_start_of_route(j, rj):
            routes[ri] = routes[ri][::-1] + routes[rj]
        else:
            continue

        loads[ri] = li + lj
        for node in routes[rj]:
            route_of[node] = ri
        routes[rj] = []
        loads[rj] = 0

    routes = [r for r in routes if r]

    # --- Small targeted edits: intra-route improvement repeated; add inter-route exchange ---
    def two_opt_best(rt):
        nrt = len(rt)
        if nrt < 4:
            return False
        best_delta = 0
        best_i = best_j = -1
        base_cost = route_cost(rt)
        for i in range(nrt - 1):
            for j in range(i + 2, nrt):
                if i == 0 and j == nrt - 1:
                    continue
                rt2 = rt[:i + 1] + rt[i + 1:j + 1][::-1] + rt[j + 1:]
                d = route_cost(rt2) - base_cost
                if d < best_delta:
                    best_delta = d
                    best_i, best_j = i, j
        if best_delta < -1e-9:
            rt[:] = rt[:best_i + 1] + rt[best_i + 1:best_j + 1][::-1] + rt[best_j + 1:]
            return True
        return False

    def two_opt_improve(rt):
        changed = False
        while two_opt_best(rt):
            changed = True
        return changed

    def relocate_improve(routes, max_passes):
        loads_local = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        costs_local = [route_cost(r) for r in routes]
        improved_any = False

        def best_insert_pos(route, node, base_cost):
            best_delta = 0
            best_pos = -1
            m = len(route)
            for pos in range(m + 1):
                newr = route[:pos] + [node] + route[pos:]
                d = route_cost(newr) - base_cost
                if d < best_delta:
                    best_delta = d
                    best_pos = pos
            return best_pos, best_delta

        for _ in range(max_passes):
            improved = False
            k = len(routes)
            for a in range(k):
                ra = routes[a]
                if not ra:
                    continue
                for idx in range(len(ra)):
                    node = ra[idx]
                    rem_route = ra[:idx] + ra[idx + 1:]
                    rem_load = loads_local[a] - demands[node]
                    if rem_load < 0:
                        continue
                    new_cost_a = route_cost(rem_route)
                    for b in range(k):
                        if b == a:
                            continue
                        if loads_local[b] + demands[node] > capacity:
                            continue
                        rb = routes[b]
                        pos, _ = best_insert_pos(rb, node, costs_local[b])
                        if pos == -1:
                            continue
                        new_rb = rb[:pos] + [node] + rb[pos:]
                        new_cost_b = route_cost(new_rb)
                        delta_total = (new_cost_a + new_cost_b) - (costs_local[a] + costs_local[b])
                        if delta_total < -1e-9:
                            routes[a] = rem_route
                            routes[b] = new_rb
                            loads_local[a] = rem_load
                            loads_local[b] = loads_local[b] + demands[node]
                            costs_local[a] = new_cost_a
                            costs_local[b] = new_cost_b
                            improved = True
                            improved_any = True
                            break
                    if improved:
                        break
                if improved:
                    break
            if not improved:
                break

        routes = [r for r in routes if r]
        return routes, improved_any

    def exchange_improve(routes, max_attempts):
        loads_local = [route_load(r) for r in routes]
        costs_local = [route_cost(r) for r in routes]
        k = len(routes)
        improved_any = False
        attempts = 0

            if not routes[a]:
                continue
            for b in range(a + 1, k):
                if not routes[b]:
                    continue
                ra = routes[a]
                rb = routes[b]
                for ia in range(len(ra)):
                    if attempts >= max_attempts:
                        return routes, improved_any
                    node_a = ra[ia]
                    for ib in range(len(rb)):
                        if attempts >= max_attempts:
                            return routes, improved_any
                        node_b = rb[ib]
                        attempts += 1

                        new_load_a = loads_local[a] - demands[node_a] + demands[node_b]
                        new_load_b = loads_local[b] - demands[node_b] + demands[node_a]
                        if new_load_a > capacity or new_load_b > capacity:
                            continue

                        new_ra = ra[:ia] + [node_b] + ra[ia + 1:]
                        new_rb = rb[:ib] + [node_a] + rb[ib + 1:]

                        new_cost_a = route_cost(new_ra)
                        new_cost_b = route_cost(new_rb)
                        delta = (new_cost_a + new_cost_b) - (costs_local[a] + costs_local[b])
                        if delta < -1e-9:
                            routes[a] = new_ra
                            routes[b] = new_rb
                            loads_local[a] = new_load_a
                            loads_local[b] = new_load_b
                            costs_local[a] = new_cost_a
                            costs_local[b] = new_cost_b
                            improved_any = True
